components.name: Margin thought
components.description: A native keyboard-accessible disclosure adjacent to its reading passage.
components.html:
One thought in the margin

Illustrative approach note.

narrative.overview: Desaturated slate gives the page the quiet material presence of a notebook under evening light. Writing does the work; margins carry a second, quieter voice. This is a reading surface, not an archive claiming already-published material.
dos: Do keep factual framing distinct from illustrative prose.
Do keep paragraphs continuous and readable.
donts: Don't introduce saturated plum, neon, cards, diagrams, or a poster-like scale.
Don't invent published dates or proof.
